description: This file defines a live wallpaper service for Android that renders a rotating 3D wireframe shape (cube or other shape), with preferences to select shape, handles touch events for interaction, and manages rendering and resource loading.
external_files: R array resources for shape definitions

classes.name: CubeWallpaper2
classes.description: Main WallpaperService class that initializes the service and creates an embedded engine for rendering the cube

classes.name: CubeEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending Engine that handles drawing, user interaction, resource loading, and animation logic for the live wallpaper

classes.name: ThreeDPoint
classes.description: Simple data structure representing a 3D point with x, y, z coordinates

classes.name: ThreeDLine
classes.description: Structure representing a line by storing indices of start and end points

methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the service is created

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the service is destroyed
